Only b and d are the miR-31 experiments (see channel-map claims). Out of scope / blocked (also in annotations/BLOCKED.md): experiments a and c (SCX_1_*, SCX_3_*; 22 RAW; deposited Perseus lists call them L125 - miRNA identity undocumented), the whole Velos search 20170620_V1_MJW_0083.zip (80 RAW 20170609_V1_MJW_0083_C1-C12,D1-D8,G1-G12,H1-H8 and 20170620_V1_MJW_0083_A1-A12,B1-B8,E1-E12,F1-F8; channel map/condition and cell line undocumented) and 4 never-searched Velos RAW 20170609_V1_MJW_0083_1..4 (absent from every summary.txt). The 2 .zip files are search output, not runs.

One source per SILAC-labelled culture: each MaxQuant experiment (b, d) is one 1:1 light/heavy mixture of a miR-31-mimic and a control-mimic transfected culture (paper/PRIDE: lysates mixed 1:1 in forward and reverse mode). Four distinct cultures, four source names; mixB/mixD = MaxQuant experiment b (SCX_2) / d (SCX_4).

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[treatment] + factor value[treatment] rows 1-22 (SCX_2_*, experiment b)
claims.value: SILAC light = hsa-miR-31-5p mimic; SILAC heavy = control miRNA mimic
claims.evidence: Design statement (paper Methods "SILAC experiment setup" and PRIDE protocol): miRNA-transfected lysate from heavy medium + control (SCR) from light medium = reverse mode, and vice versa = forward mode. Which MaxQuant experiment is which orientation is not written anywhere, so it was determined from the deposited ratios: log2 H/L of experiment b vs Dataset EV1 HEK 293T "Log fc (miR-31/Ctrl)" Pearson r = -0.95 (n=1036 proteins, sign agreement 28/1036 i.e. inverted) -> b H/L = control/miR-31 -> miR-31 light. Deposited Perseus lists L31up.txt / L31down.txt agree: their genes have negative b and positive d ratios (e.g. L31up SBNO1 b -1.04 d +0.94; L31down ATF7 b +1.00 d -1.20). Markers: TACC1 (EV1 HEK -1.95) b +1.84 d -2.18; POMP (EV1 +2.04) b -1.75 d +2.20; ANKRD52 (EV1 -1.67) b +1.32 d -2.14.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[treatment] + factor value[treatment] rows 23-44 (SCX_4_*, experiment d)
claims.value: SILAC heavy = hsa-miR-31-5p mimic; SILAC light = control miRNA mimic
claims.evidence: Experiment d log2 H/L vs Dataset EV1 HEK 293T log fc (miR-31/Ctrl): r = +0.96 (n=1033, sign agreement 1018/1033) -> H/L = miR-31/control -> miR-31 heavy. b vs d log2 H/L over all proteins r = -0.29 (label swap). limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 22 of 128 RAW annotated. Blocked (annotations/BLOCKED.md section PXD029030): (1) SCX experiments a and c (20161111_F1_RM_RH_SCX_1_1..11, _3_1..11): the deposit names them only "L125" (zip name SCX_L125_L31, Perseus lists L125up/L125down); neither the paper nor PRIDE mentions a second miRNA, so the treatment identity and its channel map are undocumented. (2) The Velos search 20170620_V1_MJW_0083.zip, 80 RAW (experiments AB, CD, EF, GH) plus 4 never-searched RAW 20170609_V1_MJW_0083_1..4: no source states their cell line or conditions; the PRIDE/paper protocol text speaks of miR-130a/miR-708 vs SCR mixtures (apparently copied from another study) and of an Orbitrap Fusion, whereas these are LTQ Orbitrap Velos CID runs; their ratios do not reproduce Dataset EV1 HaCaT (best combined r = 0.29, n = 533; GLUL agrees, ANKRD52 opposes) and correlate with the "L125" experiments (a vs AB 0.29, c vs GH 0.28) rather than with the miR-31 experiments (|r| <= 0.12). They might be the HaCaT miR-31 SILAC of Fig EV1E, but this cannot be shown.

The cell line of the annotated SCX runs (HEK293T) is not written in any deposited text; it is derived from the match of the deposited ratios to Dataset EV1 HEK 293T columns (r 0.96/-0.95 vs 0.80/-0.79 for HaCaT). The paper Methods describe the SILAC labelling for HaCaT only.
Channel orientation of b and d is data-derived (Dataset EV1 correlation + deposited Perseus L31up/L31down lists); the generic forward/reverse design is stated in the paper/PRIDE.
Heavy label: paper/PRIDE text says 13C6-Arg / "3C6"-Lys, deposited MaxQuant search uses Arg10;Lys8; the SDRF follows the search output.
Fractionation chemistry (SCX) is taken from the file names; the paper describes UPLC fractionation "based on molecular mass".
characteristics[treatment] values are free text (no ontology term for a miRNA mimic); validate-sdrf emits warnings only.
